description: Independent standard-lane target screen under severe-congestion and launch-day load overrides. Flat fee and a patient demand-census control are paired with canonical D16/K10, a fixed-standard priority-only ablation, and standard target utilisation {0.625, 0.75, 0.875} while urgent target 0.5, D16, windows 20/5, half-RB threshold, K10, and all other inputs stay fixed. The census arm always first-submits and supplies the common offered-demand denominator; its own inclusion outcomes are not candidates.
